_readme: Every image in assets/ needs a row here: what it is, where it came from, the prompt or search that produced it, and its licence. scripts/check-assets.js fails CI if anything is unrecorded. The Lucide icon set (assets/icons/) is recorded once, below, rather than file by file.

sets.name: Lucide outline icon set (59 glyphs)
sets.note: 48 glyphs added 2026-09-21; wheat-off, milk-off, sprout, ban, log-out, mail, gift, megaphone, scan-line, image-plus and share added 2026-09-25 (lucide-static 0.542.0) for the docs/05 dietary tags and the sign-in, install and staff screens.
